ly_ultrabiotic_dms.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain
ly_ultrabiotic_dms.key: Per capsule: 30 billion CFU when made, 7 strains: 5 billion S. boulardii (a yeast) and six bacteria (Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium, Bacillus)
ly_ultrabiotic_dms.src: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain sell sheet ND460 (Rev. 7/24; Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials, opened 2026-11-03 and re-read with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-04): Supplement Facts per 1 capsule (30/60 servings): Saccharomyces boulardii Lynside 5 Billion CFU, Lactobacillus reuteri LRC 5 Billion CFU, and Bifidobacterium lactis UABla-12, L. plantarum UALp-05, L. acidophilus UALa-01, L. gasseri UALg-05 and Bacillus coagulans UABc-20 at 4.167 Billion CFU each, every amount marked with the label's dagger note 'At time of manufacture'. Its text says the capsule 'contains 30 billion colony-forming units (CFU) of a potent seven-strain blend'; the seven panel amounts add to about 30.8 billion, so the sheet prints only the stated 30 billion and S. boulardii's own 5 billion, never a derived figure. Other Ingredients: 'Hypromellose, vegetable magnesium stearate, silica.'; badges dairy-free and vegetarian (no milk or gelatin, which is why the alpha-gal line does not name it). Directions 'Take one capsule daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' Claim used: 'Support a healthy gut microbiome' (ND460's own list). The same strains and total CFU are in every product DB R829 chart read (catalog ND143 10/1/26; Standard Process chart: 'Saccharomyces boulardii: NutriDyn 5 billion CFU'). The serving line states its basis (per capsule, and 'when made', the label's 'at time of manufacture' in plain words, printed from polish round 2 so the count is not read as what the capsule holds when it is taken), gives S. boulardii its own 5 billion so the yeast is not read as the whole count, and spells out the three bacterial genera (four Lactobacillus strains, one Bifidobacterium, one Bacillus) so no 'B.' can be read two ways; the species list stays here. The line 'when made' needs is paid for by bullet 2, now two lines ('Antibiotics spare its yeast, not its bacteria'; S. boulardii is named in the header and the serving line). Sizes R829 30C / R829L 60C (ND144 price list 10/1/26, via the product DB). URL slug from products.SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc). Bedtime slot and the 2-hour antibiotic gap are this sheet's timing advice, not label text.

ly_immune_prp.name: Immune PRP Pro
ly_immune_prp.key: Per 4 capsules: 1,720 mg bovine colostrum, standardized to 30% IgG antibodies, with PRP, IgA, IgM and lactoferrin
ly_immune_prp.src: Immune PRP Pro sell sheet ND1054 (Rev. 8/24; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 4 capsules (30 servings): Bovine Colostrum Blend [immunoglobulin G (IgG), proline-rich polypeptides (PRP), other immunoglobulins (IgA, IgM), lactoferrin] (standardized to 30% IgG) 1,720 mg; Contains: Milk. Label directions, verbatim: 'Take four capsules twice daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' The sheet prints that label dose (8 capsules a day, so one 120-capsule bottle lasts 15 days). Same facts and the same directions in labels.json (R2178) and in NutriDyn's own 60-day protocol doc 'NUTRIDYN FORMULAS Protocols - 60 Day Gut Repair and Detox' (2025-04-28): 'Take four capsules twice daily'. Protocol basis for the pick: the NutriDyn GLC 2019 protocol sheet "Botanical Medicines in Complex, Multi-Pathogen Disease" (Dropbox Seminar Notes and Protocols/GLC 2019), Immune Support, which uses a lower practitioner dose ('Immune PRP Pro (R2178) 2 capsules 2x/day'); a practitioner who wants that dose writes it under Special considerations. Size R2178 120C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). Other ingredients (labels.json R2178): hypromellose, vegetable magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, silica; Contains: Milk (re-read in ND1054 itself with the Dropbox fetch tool, 2026-11-04). Claims used, both from ND1054: 'Promotes healthy immune function' (word for word, from its list of benefits) and 'Supports the gut lining', the plain-words form of the same list's 'Supports gastrointestinal tract integrity' and of its text 'bovine colostrum promotes gastrointestinal health by bolstering the gut lining and promoting healthy gut integrity'; tagline 'Pure Bovine Colostrum for Immune Health'. So the capsule is not gelatin, and the milk (colostrum) is why both check panels tell people with alpha-gal or milk allergy to skip it. URL (polish round 1, 2026-11-03): NutriDyn practitioner storefront pages in the web index serve this product at the URL key 'immune-prp-pro', and storefront keys match the www keys (Mito Recharge is 'mito-recharge-r167' on both); nutridyn.com itself cannot be opened from the build session, so the page was not loaded in a browser. PHOTO: the sheet still prints the SOFT 4x stopgap (img-src/R2178.png, 352x640 from a 160 px thumbnail). Print sources found 2026-11-03: Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R2178_Web, 2026-05-13, the current NutriDyn web render) and an older 2019 render, /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/Marketing Club/_gsdata_/_saved_/2019/10. October - Immune Health/web/immune_prp_pro.png; check it shows the current label before use). Not downloadable from the build session (dl.dropboxusercontent.com is denied by its network policy); stage the chosen file centrally as build/img-src/R2178.png and drop R2178 from img-src/soft.json.

ly_inflam_eze.name: Inflam-Eze Plus
ly_inflam_eze.key: Per 3 capsules: 800 mg ginger root; extracts: 250 mg CurQfen (curcumin with fenugreek fiber), 250 mg boswellia, 200 mg white willow bark, 150 mg hops, 60 mg devil’s claw
ly_inflam_eze.src: Inflam-Eze Plus sell sheet ND516 (Rev. 5/25; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 3 capsules: ginger powder (root) 800 mg; proprietary mix of curcumin extract (35% curcuminoids) and fenugreek galactomannans extract (CurQfen) 250 mg; Boswellia serrata gum extract (65% boswellic acid) 250 mg; white willow extract (bark; 25% salicin) 200 mg; hops extract (2% xanthohumol) 150 mg; devil's claw extract (1.2% harpagosides) 60 mg; directions 'Take 3 capsules once daily with food or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' The serving line keeps every amount, each joined to its unit by a no-break space so a number never ends a line (polish round 2; still seven lines, measured), and says which are extracts: 250 mg is the CurQfen complex (curcumin with fenugreek fiber), not 250 mg of curcumin, and 200 mg is a bark extract, not raw bark. Same panel in labels.json (R856/R856L) and the product DB (Ortho, Metagenics, Nutritional Frontiers chart reads). ND516's claims, re-read 2026-11-03 (Dropbox text extraction): 'Promote healthy inflammatory markers in the body', 'Support healthy immune function and oxidative stress', 'Support overall health and well-being'; it calls the 800 mg 'ginger root powder'. The sheet prints the first and the third, and no joint claim. Other ingredients (labels.json R856): hypromellose, microcrystalline cellulose, vegetable magnesium stearate, silica (no gelatin or milk, so the alpha-gal line names only Immune PRP Pro). Sizes R856 90C / R856L 180C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). Protocol basis: a NutriDyn educator's product key maps 'Botanical Anti-inflam' to Inflam-eze Plus in the Gut-Neuro-Immune Restoration care plan (1-3 breakfast, 1-3 supper) from Asher's 2025 fatigue/immune seminar, which covered tick-borne disease. URL slug from products.SLUGS (inflam_eze).

ly_glutathione.name: Liposomal Glutathione
ly_glutathione.key: 100 mg reduced L-glutathione per 1 mL dropper, in liposomes made with sunflower lecithin
ly_glutathione.src: Liposomal Glutathione sell sheet ND971 (Rev. 8/24; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 1 dropper (1 mL), 60 servings: L-glutathione (reduced) 100 mg; Other Ingredients (re-read in ND971 itself with the Dropbox fetch tool, 2026-11-04): 'Purified water, vegetable glycerin, natural strawberry watermelon flavor, non-GMO sunflower lecithin, stevia leaf extract, organic cane alcohol.'; badges dairy-free and vegetarian; claim used 'Supports healthy glutathione levels' (ND971's list). The size line says 'contains alcohol' (polish round 2; the label gives no amount) for readers who avoid alcohol: metronidazole and tinidazole labels warn against alcohol during treatment and for 3 days after, some practitioners add them to Lyme regimens, and some people avoid it altogether. It is short enough to stay on one line under the name, as the old '60 mL liquid' did; directions 'Shake well. Take one full dropper (1 mL) 2-4 times daily'; tagline 'Bioavailable Antioxidant and Detox Support'. Same amount and directions in the product DB (R2188, five chart reads). Size R2188 60 mL (ND144 price list 10/1/26). Protocol basis: the NutriDyn GLC 2019 protocol sheet "Botanical Medicines in Complex, Multi-Pathogen Disease" (Dropbox Seminar Notes and Protocols/GLC 2019), 'Detoxification Support - for herxing: Liposomal Glutathione (R2188) 5 pumps up to 4x/day as needed for herxing'. URL (polish round 1, 2026-11-03): the web index lists nutridyn.com/liposomal-glutathione as the 60 mL product page (also under /metabolic-detoxification/liposomal-glutathione); nutridyn.com itself cannot be opened from the build session, so the page was not loaded in a browser. Timing on the sheet: morning and evening meal (the label sets no time of day; glutathione has no minerals, so doxycycline spacing does not apply). PHOTO: the sheet still prints the SOFT 4x stopgap (img-src/R2188.png, 208x640 from a 160 px thumbnail). Print source found 2026-11-03: Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R2188_web, 2026-05-13, the current NutriDyn web render; no larger Liposomal Glutathione image found in Dropbox). Not downloadable from the build session (dl.dropboxusercontent.com is denied by its network policy); stage the chosen file centrally as build/img-src/R2188.png and drop R2188 from img-src/soft.json.

ly_mito.name: Mito Recharge
ly_mito.key: Per 3 capsules, including 300 mg taurine, 200 mg acetyl-L-carnitine, 100 mg CoQ10, 75 mg alpha-lipoic + 45 mg R-lipoic acid, 75 mg magnesium, 250 mcg vitamin K1
sched: capsules with a snack, 2 to 3 hours from doxycycline
ly_mito.src: Mito Recharge sell sheet ND812 (Rev. 2/25; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, re-opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 3 capsules (30 servings): vitamin C 150 mg, vitamin E 25 mg, vitamin K1 250 mcg, thiamin 25 mg, riboflavin 12 mg, niacin 12 mg NE, B6 (P5P) 7.5 mg, magnesium 75 mg (malate, ascorbate), selenium 25 mcg, taurine 300 mg, acetyl-L-carnitine HCl 200 mg, resveratrol 100 mg, CoQ10 100 mg, NAC 100 mg, EGCG 100 mg, quercetin 100 mg, alpha-lipoic acid 75 mg, R-alpha-lipoic acid 45 mg, sulforaphane glucosinolate 15 mg, hydroxytyrosol 10 mg, PQQ 7 mg; directions three capsules daily. The same panel is in the mold and fatty-liver products.d notes; product DB R167 (CellCore chart read) agrees on CoQ10 100 mg, acetyl-L-carnitine 200 mg, PQQ 7 mg, alpha-lipoic acid 75 mg, R-alpha-lipoic acid 45 mg and magnesium 75 mg (as malate and ascorbate). Re-read in ND812 itself with the Dropbox fetch tool, 2026-11-04: the EGCG line reads 'EGCG (epigallocatechin-3-gallate) 100 mg (from green tea extract; leaf; Camellia sinensis)'; Other Ingredients: 'Hypromellose, vegetable magnesium stearate, silica.'; badges dairy-free and vegetarian (no milk or gelatin, so the alpha-gal line need not name it); caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use' (no green tea wording on the label). Claims used: 'Promotes healthy antioxidant status' (ND812's list: 'Promote healthy antioxidant status') and 'Supports your cells' energy production', the plain-words form of the tagline 'Promotes Healthy Cellular Energy Production' and of the text 'Mito Recharge supports energy production in the mitochondria'. The serving line says 'including', because it shows 6 of the label's actives: taurine, the largest, then carnitine, CoQ10, the two lipoic acids as the label prints them (polish round 2: '75 mg alpha-lipoic + 45 mg R-lipoic acid', as on the fatty-liver and mold sheets; the old single '120 mg' was a sum no label prints, and NAC 100 mg was dropped to keep the seven lines), and the two the check panels rely on: magnesium and vitamin K1. Size R167 90C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). The magnesium is why it sits away from doxycycline: the sheet puts it at bedtime, because twice-daily doxycycline is taken with breakfast and the evening meal and not right before lying down, so bedtime is the only slot 2 to 3 hours from both doses (the timing is this sheet's advice, not label text; the protocol below spreads it over breakfast and supper, beside each doxycycline dose). WITH A SNACK (polish round 2): the green tea extract is taken with food, never fasting, per the label caution in USP's Powdered Decaffeinated Green Tea Extract monograph ('Do not take on an empty stomach. Take with food. Do not use if you have a liver problem...') and Oketch-Rabah HA et al., Toxicol Rep 2020;7:386-402 (fasting doses raise EGCG exposure); full text and provenance in the [USP20] note of conditions/fatty_liver.py, whose sheet gives this bottle with breakfast and the same with-food and liver-problem caution. So the dose bar says 'with a snack', the rhythm says 'with a snack, 2 to 3 hours from doxycycline', and both check panels carry the green tea line. OPEN QUESTION for NutriDyn: ND812 does not say whether its green tea extract is decaffeinated and prints no caffeine amount, which matters for a bedtime dose. The vitamin K1 is why the warfarin note names it. URL slug from products.SLUGS (mito). Protocol basis: a NutriDyn educator's 'Mold Care ~ Preparation Plan' for Asher's 2025 fatigue/immune seminar (seminar materials, Google Drive) lists Mito Recharge 1-3 at breakfast and 1-3 at supper; it is also the NutriDyn match for the competitor's mitochondrial category (NAC, acetyl-L-carnitine, lipoic acid).
